title: Noise operator on bounded cube functions
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$, define its noise transform at $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ to be the expected value of $f$ on the point obtained by applying the noise kernel with parameter $\rho$ to $x$. This transform again takes values in $[-1,1]$.
